findings.title: No access control on record_payment method
findings.detail: The record_payment method can be called by any account and accepts any payment in the first transaction of the group, allowing attackers to increment totalCalls and totalEarned without proper payment verification or authorization.
findings.fix_hint: Add strict validation that the payment transaction is from the caller and part of a valid x402 payment group, or restrict record_payment to be called only by the contract itself or a trusted facilitator.

findings.title: Payment validation only checks receiver and amount, not sender or group structure
findings.detail: record_payment only asserts that gtxn[0] is a payment to the contract with amount >= pricePerCall, but does not verify that the payment is from Txn.sender or that the group transaction is correctly formed, enabling replay or spoofing attacks.
findings.fix_hint: Validate that the payment transaction sender matches Txn.sender and that the group transaction structure complies with the x402 protocol requirements.

findings.title: Withdraw uses totalEarned as amount without checking actual contract balance
findings.detail: withdraw sends totalEarned amount to owner without verifying the contract's actual balance, risking failure if funds are insufficient or locked.
findings.fix_hint: Check the contract's actual balance before withdrawal and adjust amount accordingly or revert if insufficient.
